metadata.title: The microbial diversity of Rub' al-Khali (Empty Quarter)
metadata.description:
This dataset contains version 3.0.1 of the Rub al-Khali microbial survey knowledge graph, integrating microbiome and environmental data from five expeditions covering 60 core sampling sites and 10 named locations of special interest in the Rub al-Khali (Empty Quarter), Saudi Arabia.

The graph connects 16S rRNA amplicon profiles and taxon read abundances with sampling metadata, environmental observations, climate data, archived-soil pH measurements, X-ray fluorescence (XRF) geochemistry, and provenance. It supports investigation of desert microbial diversity and its associations with environmental conditions through linked-data queries and integration with other datasets.

Version 3.0.1 contains 45,707,660 asserted RDF triples, distributed across 16 modules. The accompanying OWL ontology provides English-language definitions for 342 project terms and reuses established vocabularies, including SIO, ENVO, PATO, and UO. The release contains asserted statements only; inferred triples are not included.

Release resources include the compressed graph in N-Quads format, individual RDF modules, the project ontology, rebuild materials, machine-readable discovery metadata, validation records, and checksums. Project-authored RDF data, ontology terms, and metadata are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Imported ontologies and other third-party resources retain their respective licences and attribution requirements, as documented in the accompanying notices. Software is licensed separately under MIT.

Interactive exploration and documentation: https://rubalkhali.science/  
Source code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/bio-ontology-research-group/empty-quarter-data-paper
